reason: Most collagen is bovine or fish gelatine I can't trust, so a certificate number I can check myself plus batch lab results is rare. For £4.95 I'll try the 7-day pack in my chai, but only once I've looked up the certifier and confirmed they're one I accept.
objection: Which certifier it is matters. Some bodies accept things I don't, and with bovine collagen I need to know the cattle were slaughtered halal. Also I doubt I'll keep stirring an unflavoured powder into my tea every day once the novelty wears off.
would_change_my_mind: If the certifier turned out to be one I don't trust, or the certificate didn't cover the collagen source itself, I'd walk away.
